name_note: The genus name is recent: genomes GTDB places in g__Holdemanella also appear in NCBI under Eubacterium and Solobacterium, and the type species was published as Eubacterium biforme.

sentences.text: Holdemanella is a genus of the family Erysipelotrichaceae created when species misclassified in the genus Eubacterium, including Eubacterium biforme, were reclassified; Eubacterium biforme became Holdemanella biformis.
Holdemanella biformis has been isolated from the feces of a metabolically healthy human volunteer.
A study identified Holdemanella biformis as the human counterpart of the murine Faecalibaculum rodentium and reported both strongly under-represented during tumourigenesis.
That study reported that Holdemanella biformis produced short-chain fatty acids that contributed to control of protein acetylation and tumour cell proliferation in mouse and human settings.
A study of chronic kidney disease reported the genus Holdemanella among taxa associated with progression of chronic kidney disease and hemodialysis.
